changes: WardrobeVideo screen binds/initializes worker and destroys it on cleanup
Explicit boolean result contract distinguishes valid published scan from failed/cancelled analysis
Retry disabled while initial photo, current analysis or existing review result occupies the screen
Only one successful result published per worker pass
Background retry opts out of duplicate enqueue and modal failure alerts
Transport/timeout categories preserved separately from provider errors; vendor failure is not disguised as offline transport
Normal queue acknowledgement waits for persistence flush and current identity
Interrupted owner processing entries recover to pending at worker initialization/destruction; unreachable network consumes no attempt
limitations: Integration tests execute actual extracted screen effect with real worker/hook/store and mocked provider/connectivity/storage; not native device E2E
Retry operates only while the review screen is mounted, not as an OS background task
Temporary native file URIs are not copied to durable queue-specific media storage yet
Legacy unowned entries, full restart recovery, exhausted-entry UI/manual retry and queued media cleanup remain incomplete
No new live NVIDIA capacity test; 10k DAU readiness remains unproven
